[[File:Oovo_IV.png|thumb|right|250px|The Oovo asteroid belt, containing [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]], orbiting the gas giant [[Oovo]].]]
The '''Oovo asteroid belt''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] that orbited the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Oovo]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The most infamous [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the belt was [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]], the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] asteroid containing the maximum security federal prison [[Desolation Alley]].
